name: TITANAGE
desc:
-------------------------
Welcome to Titanage where you'll battle monstrous titans, form squads with friends, and ascend to higher ranks of prestige! But beware: maintaining your progress requires careful navigation through formidable challenges. This game isn't for the faint-hearted—be prepared! (Note: Permadeath Titan game. Progress is lost upon death.)
----------------------
Codes:
COLOSSALSTOMP25 - 5000
TITANSERUM25 - 25000
AOT2025 - 10000
EREHYEAGER25 - 5000
--------------------
[ Controls ]:
WASD Keys for PC
W- 2x W and hold down to sprint.
F - Draw Blades.
R - Reload Blades.
Q - Left Grapple.
E - Right Grapple.
A - Left Drift.
D - Right Drift.
Spacebar - Boost.
H - Opens flare GUI.
M1 - to swing/slash.
--------------------------     
Weekend Bonuses:
- 2x Mod Drops and 2x Accessory Drops on the weekends!
- XBOX compatibility! 
- Check out the Trello and in-game cash codes in the server link below!
